The Software Engineer I at Confidential Client is an entry-level role focused on contributing to product development within an agile team. The position involves designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining software features across front-end, back-end, and AI-related technologies, with structured mentorship to develop technical skills and ownership of increasingly complex tasks. This role offers growth opportunities in a collaborative environment supporting innovative AI-enabled retail and product lifecycle solutions.

Description

About Careertakes

👉 Important disclosure: Careertakes is a third-party recruiting platform supporting this hiring process. If selected, you will be employed directly by our client, IT.

Applicants for this role may also receive access to additional matched opportunities through the Careertakes platform.

Responsibilities

This entry-level Software Engineer role supports product development on agile teams. Work with engineers, product managers, and QA to deliver customer-facing features, resolve defects, and grow your technical skills.

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain software features under the guidance of experienced engineers
  • Deliver on user stories, product enhancements, and defect fixes as part of an agile sprint
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code that follows established engineering standards
  • Participate in code reviews and apply feedback to improve code quality
  • Investigate defects, identify root causes, and implement fixes
  • Learn the application architecture and integrate changes safely with the broader codebase

Technical Areas

Depending on team assignment and product needs, you may contribute in one or more areas:

  • Full-stack development (TypeScript/JavaScript, React, Java, Node.js)
  • Front-end UI and component work for responsive, accessible experiences
  • Back-end services, APIs, and business logic focused on reliability and performance
  • Database design and queries for relational and NoSQL systems
  • Projects involving AI or machine learning (NLP, LLMs) where applicable

Engineering Practices

  • Participate across the software development lifecycle: requirements, design, implementation, testing, deployment
  • Use source control, CI/CD, automated tests, and issue tracking as part of team workflows
  • Create unit and integration tests to reduce regressions
  • Apply secure, scalable, and maintainable engineering practices
  • Use modern tools — including AI-assisted development tools when appropriate — while maintaining engineering accountability

Collaboration & Growth

  • Collaborate with engineers, QA, product managers, and stakeholders
  • Ask questions, seek feedback, and communicate technical progress and risks
  • Work with a mentor and engineering manager to set goals and build technical depth
  • Take increasing ownership of features from implementation through delivery
  • Contribute to design reviews, sprint planning, and a collaborative engineering culture

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • Foundational knowledge of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and software design
  • Programming experience from coursework, internships, projects, or professional work
  • Experience with at least one modern language (Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C++, etc.)
  • Understanding of web application concepts, APIs, databases, and client/server architecture
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective written and verbal communication
  • Ability and willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies and work within a large codebase
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively on a software development team

Preferred

  • Java and Java-based server-side development
  • JavaScript/TypeScript and modern front-end frameworks (React, Angular)
  • Node.js, HTML, CSS, SQL, NoSQL databases, REST APIs
  • Git, Bitbucket, Jira, Jenkins or other CI/CD tools
  • Unit testing frameworks (JUnit, etc.)
  • Cloud and container technologies
  • Familiarity with NLP, ML or Large Language Models and AI-assisted development tools

What Success Looks Like (Year 1)

  • Become proficient with the codebase, tools, and product architecture
  • Successfully complete well-defined engineering tasks with guidance
  • Independently investigate and resolve defects
  • Consistently deliver maintainable, tested code and incorporate feedback
  • Communicate clearly about requirements, technical decisions, and risks
  • Progress toward ownership of features and toward a Software Engineer II level

Work Environment & Location

This role operates in a collaborative product engineering environment. Teams may be remote, hybrid, or require regular collaboration from the confidential client’s Campbell, CA office. Specific in-office expectations are determined by team needs.

Compensation (California pay-transparency)

  • Estimated: $111,883 per year (estimated figure shown in source). Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and applicable laws.

Keywords & Good Fit

This role is a match for early-career engineers seeking hands-on product experience in full-stack or back-end development, especially those with Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, or cloud familiarity.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Willingness to learn and accept mentorship
  • Interest in scalable systems, APIs, and modern web technologies
